title: ScopeGuard research checkpoints
provenance: Original ScopeGuard research prompts, organized with background reading from established public security guides. Not copied standard requirements, an OWASP certification, an exhaustive list, or a claim that every researcher or AI uses these exact checks.
limits: Catalog entries are not executed tests, testing permission, confirmed bugs, or promised earnings. Applicability depends on actual features and current program rules. Some areas require specialist tools and controlled environments.
